artifact_types: preflight result with blocking-finding register, evidence-gap list and residual-risk summary
forbidden_actions: remote Git, merge, deploy, release, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent product facts, brand authority, copy claims, customer data, assets, evidence, or approval
perform an adjacent capability or combine independent review with source repair
treat static inspection, stale capture, or model self-report as current rendered evidence
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: No release criterion may pass from source inspection, prior screenshots, or reviewer assertion when current rendered or interaction evidence is required.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: An implementation, desktop and mobile captures, a brief, direction contract, target files, and findings; in preflight mode, a rendered UI or build, acceptance criteria, content, supported devices, and the release boundary.
outputs: preflight result with blocking-finding register, evidence-gap list and residual-risk summary
responsibility: Apply explicit UI release criteria to current rendered evidence, or run a bounded cross-domain preflight before capture, aggregate blocking findings, and recommend a bounded release disposition without source repair.
